content.value_statement: Moving from older Claude models can break model names, beta headers, and prompt behavior. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a focused migration checklist.
actual_capabilities: Finds Claude Sonnet 4.0, Sonnet 4.5, and Opus 4.1 model strings in project files.
Maps Anthropic API, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Azure AI Foundry strings to Opus 4.5.
Flags the unsupported 1M context beta header and suggests a clear explanatory comment.
Guides optional prompt updates for tool overtriggering, code exploration, frontend design, and thinking terminology.
Explains when to add the Opus 4.5 effort parameter and which levels fit common workloads.
limitations: It does not migrate Claude Haiku models to Opus 4.5.
It depends on the host assistant to inspect and edit the user project correctly.
It does not verify live provider availability or pricing for Opus 4.5.
Prompt snippets should only be applied when the user reports the matching behavior.

use_cases.title: Update API Integrations
use_cases.description: Replace older Claude model identifiers across API, Bedrock, Vertex AI, or Azure integration code.

use_cases.title: Adjust Production Prompts
use_cases.description: Tune prompts after migration when Opus 4.5 changes tool use, exploration, or reasoning language behavior.

use_cases.title: Review Migration Scope
use_cases.description: Use a concise checklist to confirm model changes, unsupported beta headers, effort settings, and migration notes.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Model Update
prompt_templates.scenario: A small project needs direct model string replacement.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to migrate my project from Claude Sonnet 4.5 to Claude Opus 4.5. Update only model identifiers and summarize the changes.

prompt_templates.title: API Provider Migration
prompt_templates.scenario: The project may use several Claude provider formats.
prompt_templates.prompt: Scan the relevant files for Claude model strings across Anthropic API, Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Azure. Replace supported source models with Opus 4.5 strings.

prompt_templates.title: Prompt Behavior Fix
prompt_templates.scenario: A migrated prompt calls tools too often or explores code poorly.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this prompt for Opus 4.5 behavior issues. Apply only the matching snippets for tool overtriggering, code exploration, or thinking terminology.

prompt_templates.title: Full Migration Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: A team wants a complete migration pass with documented decisions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a full Opus 4.5 migration review. Check model strings, unsupported beta headers, effort settings, prompt adjustments, exclusions, and provide a change summary.

output_examples.input: Migrate a service from Claude Sonnet 4.5 to Claude Opus 4.5.
output_examples.output: The assistant reports changed model names, any removed unsupported beta header, the selected effort setting, and files that were left unchanged.

output_examples.input: A migrated prompt now calls tools too frequently.
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies aggressive tool-triggering language and recommends softer wording while preserving the original prompt structure.

output_examples.input: Check whether Haiku 4.5 should be migrated.
output_examples.output: The assistant explains that Haiku models are out of scope and should not be converted by this skill.

best_practices: Inspect relevant files before proposing edits or changing model identifiers.
Apply optional prompt snippets only when the user reports the matching issue.
Document every model string, beta header, and effort setting changed during migration.
anti_patterns: Do not migrate Haiku model identifiers to Opus 4.5.
Do not append every prompt snippet without checking the reported problem.
Do not remove unrelated beta headers or rewrite unrelated prompt sections.

faq.question: What source models does this skill migrate?
faq.answer: It targets Claude Sonnet 4.0, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Claude Opus 4.1 migrations to Claude Opus 4.5.

faq.question: Does it migrate Haiku models?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly says not to migrate any Claude Haiku model identifiers.

faq.question: Which providers are covered?
faq.answer: It includes model string guidance for Anthropic API, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Azure AI Foundry.

faq.question: Does it always change prompts?
faq.answer: No. Prompt changes are optional and should only be applied for a specific reported Opus 4.5 behavior issue.

faq.question: What beta header does it remove?
faq.answer: It instructs removal of the context-1m-2025-08-07 beta header because the guide says Opus 4.5 does not support it.

faq.question: Can Codex use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
